name: Suzuki Chiharu
source:
Like Kimiko and Shinobu, she went through the cadet program before being assigned to Hayakawa’s unit.
She pilots a bipedal Walking Tank, often serving as part of the vanguard.

Coming from an ordinary household, she lacks the standout abilities possessed by many of the other cadets.
Her gentle and timid disposition is a weakness, though she tries to mask it with forced cheerfulness, always striving to encourage those around her.

Yet her personality, ill-suited to war, together with the excellence of her comrades in the unit, weighs heavily on her, leaving her with a constant sense of inferiority.

“Am I… really someone this battalion needs?”

[From [url=http://tech-gj.jp/products/hyakki/chara/index.html#chiharu]official website[/url]]
